pull-request-header:
> [!WARNING]
> **Do not merge this pull request by hand.**
>
> Merging it creates the `X.Y.Z` tag, and therefore the production image, without the check that this exact code ran on `preview-www.kaiko.ovh` first. It is kept as a draft so that the merge button stays disabled.
>
> The **"Synchronize frontend codebase on preview" → production** button in the WordPress back-office is what merges it: it verifies that `master` HEAD is the very commit a preprod tag points at, marks this pull request ready, and merges it. Deploy to the preprod preview first, validate there, then use that button.
>
> Read it as the changelog of what is about to be released.
